summary: Iter100 - Dashboard To Do List + Note personali. Backend pytest 7/7 PASS in 3.5s (/app/backend/tests/test_iter100_dashboard_todo_notes.py): (1) GET /api/my/todo as QA admin returns {items,types} with types subset of {pipeline,attivita,followup}; each item carries all required fields (tipo,id,titolo,stato,priorita,scadenza,bucket,responsabile,evento,evento_id,can_edit); bucket in {ritardo,scadenza,da_fare}. (2) Items sorted ritardo->scadenza->da_fare and no stato in {completata,completato} is returned. (3) Full lifecycle on a real pipeline task (ev_qa_2 / Selezione location): POST /api/my/todo/complete {tipo:'pipeline',id} -> 200, item removed from /api/my/todo, GET /api/events/{id}/pipeline/tasks shows task.stato='completata'; restored to original 'da_fare' via PUT /api/pipeline/tasks/{id}. (4) POST /my/todo/complete with bogus id -> 404. (5) Notes CRUD: POST creates (text/created_at/id), newest first on GET, PUT updates text, empty text -> 400, DELETE then re-DELETE -> 404. (6) Isolation: note created by QA invisible to Super Admin; PUT/DELETE by Super Admin -> 404. (7) Persistence across logout/login: note survives new session. Frontend (Playwright, logged in as QA on /app): dashboard, dashboard-columns, todo-panel, notes-panel all present. Desktop 1920: side-by-side at same y=178, equal width 790px, equal height 856px, 20px gap, bordered rounded boxes. Old KPI data-testid dash-group-eventi NOT present (removed as required). todo-count=311, todo-group-ritardo and todo-group-da_fare render (no scadenza bucket in current data - correct, panel only shows non-empty buckets). First todo-item-{id} exposes todo-complete-{id} and todo-link-{id}. Notes: typing in note-input + Enter creates note (appears at top), inline edit via note-text-{id} triggers autosave (~1.5s wait) and 'Salvato' indicator shown; note-delete-{id} opens note-delete-dialog, note-delete-confirm removes item from DOM. Mobile 390: todo stacked above notes (todo.y=159, notes.y=599), full width 358px, no horizontal scroll. OrgMessagesBanner kept above the two columns. All cleanup done: TEST_iter100* notes removed, main-agent-created 'TEST_nota' already absent (0 notes remaining for QA user).
critical_code_review_comments: home_widgets.py _query uses stato $ne filter; when non-admin pipeline user has responsabile_id=='', the $in filter correctly includes empty/null. Good.
complete() mutates q by popping 'stato' so unmatched completed tasks return 404 (prevents double-complete). Good.

NotesPanel autosave: n.text is mutated directly (n.text = v) instead of state update after successful PUT - works but relies on next render using new value from local textarea state; acceptable since textarea holds its own state.

home_widgets.py line 48: for 'pipeline' tipo, scope ev_ids is applied via event_id without the [None,''] fallback (only attivita/followup allow unassigned event). Consistent with pipeline tasks always needing an event.
No DB index on user_notes.user_id - fine for current scale but worth adding index(user_id, created_at desc) for performance when notes grow.
